description: Return the current geomagnetic Kp index and whether an aurora can be seen from a given latitude, with the Kp needed there (France: Kp 6 in the far north, 7 to 8 in the centre, 9 in the south). Use it for 'can I see the aurora tonight'; for the solar storms behind it (CMEs) use solar, for a full night summary use tonight_sky. Live NOAA SWPC data through the Vigi-Sky API, cached 2 minutes; clouds and light pollution are not modelled.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

lat.description: Observer latitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (north positive).

lng.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

lon.description: Observer longitude in decimal degrees, WGS84 (east positive). lon and lng are aliases: give one.

name: aurora

outputSchema.description: Returns aurora {kp_current, kp_needed, visible_now, user_latitude}, citations, provenance.

title: Aurora odds for a latitude
